text:
Rae: Emergency poll: who is hoarding the glazed doughnuts from the kitchen stash? I found crumbs leading to a mysterious desk. :doughnut:
Omar: Not me. But I will confess to fueling the weekend stash once. It was a noble sacrifice. :pray:
Lina: We have an unofficial doughnut economy. You leave one, you get goodwill; you take one, you owe a meme. It's how civilization functions here. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Pat: Proposal: create a tiny ledger called "Doughnut IOU". If you take without replacing, you owe a coffee or a bad pun. React :thumbsup: if you support.
Rae: Also thinking official title: "Guardian of the Glaze" for whoever restocks. Perks: first pick on Fridays.
Omar: I nominate SnackBot to make a friendly reminder: "If you take, please replace. The glaze demands balance."
SnackBot: Reminder created: "Replace office doughnut if you take one"  Fridays 09:00am  Channel: #random.
Lina: New rule idea: If you take two doughnuts, you must document it with a selfie and a pledge to buy bagels next week. Accountability and content. :camera_with_flash:
Pat: Also can we put a tiny sticky note on the jar: "Doughnut patrons: leave a note with date/name if you commit kleptocracy." Might be slightly passive-aggressive but effective.
Rae: Tiny tradition: Friday 3pm, gather for the Glaze Council, share two-line updates and hand over a doughnut to the Guardian. No pressure. :sparkles:
Omar: Winner of the first Guardian election gets a commemorative sticker. I will design one that says "Glaze Guardian" with a tiny crown.
Lina: If anyone invents a doughnut-based economy app, I'm full-time. Until then, ledger on the fridge works.
Pat: Closing: whoever's crumbs I followed, fess up. We only want to award you with a crown and maybe a pastry-themed shame flag. :wavy_dash:
Rae: No confessions yet. The mystery deepens. I'll set up the ledger tonight. Long live the glaze.
